widgets_values:
Pose a character by dragging it, in real time, with XMAX X2.1. Load Video holds one picture as the clip: a still of a robot, taken from a frame of a Helios render of 'a small white humanoid robot with a black visor face stands in an empty light grey studio, arms held out to its sides'. Reactor Realtime loops it into the model until you press Save. In the window, press on the robot's hands and drag them up: the model follows the paths, and the prompt says what the drag means and that the pose holds. Drag with more fingers for more points, up to eight, and make each drag a smooth path. Edit the prompt and press Apply to change the edit; press Save to end the take, which is saved as a video under reactor/realtime. Cancel ends it without saving. Keep takes short: a held still drifts after about fifteen seconds.

X2.1 prompt guide: https://docs.reactor.inc/model-api-reference/xmax-x2-1/prompt-guide

Copy example_inputs/ into ComfyUI's input folder first, and set your Reactor API key in this plugin's config.ini.
